findings.message: Content may repeat a known scientific/pedagogical error: "Real gases obey the ideal gas equation exactly at every pressure and temperature."
findings.detail: Correction: An ideal gas is a theoretical model; real gases approach ideal behaviour especially at low pressures and high temperatures.
